protocol.success: two settled approach confirmations AND common grasp success AND zero approach payload contact; no error
protocol.primary_speed_metric: paired approach simulated seconds among both-success cases; report all failures separately
protocol.teacher_hard_metric: all preregistered cases with teacher2 failure; count each frozen ACT seed success, no adaptation to test
protocol.scope: Straight 20-30cm training only. Near starts overlap states in training trajectories; far starts, lateral and yaw shift unseen. Actions forward/stop only; no lateral/yaw correction trained. No object/light/FOV edits. Weld OFF.
protocol.evaluation_rule: Same initial full physics and RGB; all 32 cases all 4 conditions, same 100-round cap, rotate order; no final-test checkpoint selection
protocol.development_failure_rule: If teacher collection or development fails, diagnose there before final testing; record all exclusions/changes. Never retune on final results.
